re-binary.description: Binary analysis agent. Analyzes ELF/PE executables for structure, imports, exports, functions, strings, and security features.

re-firmware.description: Firmware analysis agent. Extracts and analyzes firmware images, filesystems, embedded kernels, and bootloaders.

re-network.description: Network analysis agent. Analyzes packet captures (pcap), protocols, traffic patterns, and network behavior.

re-kernel.description: Kernel/OS analysis agent. Analyzes kernel modules, system calls, OS internals, and driver behavior.

re-general.description: General RE orchestrator. Coordinates multi-agent analysis across binary, firmware, network, and kernel domains.
